name: Wireless Credential Capture
description: Within the target facility, the wireless attack surface expands dramatically — clients connecting to internal SSIDs expose WPA2 handshakes, NTLM credentials, and session tokens not accessible from outside the perimeter. The Wi-Fi Pineapple deployed inside captures this traffic at significantly higher fidelity than external wireless attacks. Internal wireless capture is one of the highest-yield activities once initial access is achieved.

blue.det: WIDS detects rogue AP or evil twin inside facility; clients connecting to unknown BSSID; endpoint alert on unrecognized network.
blue.cm: WPA3 Enterprise with certificate-based authentication; WIDS deployed inside facility; 802.1X preventing credential capture; network segmentation limiting blast radius.
